items.source: in favor of extractDatabaseMetaData(DataSource, DatabaseMetaDataCallback) with a lambda expression or method reference and a generically typed result
items.translation: 支持使用 lambda 表达式或方法引用以及泛型类型结果来调用 extractDatabaseMetaData(DataSource, DatabaseMetaDataCallback)。

items.source: SQLException - if thrown by the JDBC API
items.translation: SQLException - 如果由 JDBC API 抛出

items.source: dataSource - the DataSource to extract meta-data for
items.translation: dataSource - 用于提取元数据的 DataSource

items.source: Uses the getObject(index) method, but includes additional "hacks" to get around Oracle 10g returning a non-standard object for its TIMESTAMP datatype and a java.sql.Date for DATE columns leaving out the time portion: These columns will explicitly be extracted as standard java.sql.Timestamp object.
items.translation: 使用 `getObject(index)` 方法，但包含额外的“变通”处理，以绕过 Oracle 10g 为其 TIMESTAMP 数据类型返回非标准对象以及为 DATE 列返回缺少时间部分的 `java.sql.Date` 的问题：这些列将明确提取为标准 `java.sql.Timestamp` 对象。

items.source: Uses the specifically typed ResultSet accessor methods, falling back to getResultSetValue(java.sql.ResultSet, int) for unknown types.
items.translation: 使用特定类型的 ResultSet 访问器方法，对于未知类型则回退到 getResultSetValue(java.sql.ResultSet, int)。

items.source: Logs a warning if the "supportsBatchUpdates" methods throws an exception and simply returns false in that case.
items.translation: 如果 "supportsBatchUpdates" 方法抛出异常并简单地返回 `false`，则记录一条警告信息。

items.source: columnLabel - the label for the column specified with the SQL AS clause. If the SQL AS clause was not specified, then the label is the name of the column.
items.translation: columnLabel - 由 SQL AS 子句指定的列的标签。如果未指定 SQL AS 子句，则标签为列名。

items.source:
Note that the returned value may not be assignable to the specified
required type, in case of an unknown type. Calling code needs to deal
with this case appropriately, for example, throwing a corresponding exception.
items.translation: 注意，在类型未知的情况下，返回的值可能无法赋值给指定的必需类型。调用代码需要适当处理这种情况，例如抛出相应的异常。

items.source:
This method will open a connection to the database and retrieve its meta-data.
Since this method is called before the exception translation feature is configured
for a DataSource, this method can not rely on SQLException translation itself.
items.translation: 此方法将打开与数据库的连接并检索其元数据。由于在配置 DataSource 的异常翻译功能之前会调用此方法，因此该方法无法依赖 SQLException 自身的翻译机制。

items.source:
Any exceptions will be wrapped in a MetaDataAccessException. This is a checked
exception and any calling code should catch and handle this exception. You can just
log the error and hope for the best, but there is probably a more serious error that
will reappear when you try to access the database again.
items.translation: 任何异常都将被包装在 MetaDataAccessException 中。这是一个受检异常，调用代码应捕获并处理此异常。您可以简单地记录错误并希望最好，但很可能当您再次尝试访问数据库时会出现更严重的错误。

items.source:
Typically invoked right before execution of a given set of statements:
to decide whether the set of SQL statements should be executed through
the JDBC batch mechanism or simply in a traditional one-by-one fashion.
items.translation: 通常在给定的一组语句执行之前调用：以决定该组 SQL 语句是通过 JDBC 批处理机制执行，还是以传统的逐条方式执行。

items.source:
This method's implementation takes into account clarifications expressed
in the JDBC 4.0 specification:
items.translation: 此方法的实现考虑了 JDBC 4.0 规范中表达的澄清说明：

items.source:
Generic utility methods for working with JDBC. Mainly for internal use
within the framework, but also useful for custom JDBC access code.
items.translation: 用于处理 JDBC 的通用实用方法。主要用于框架内部，但也适用于自定义 JDBC 访问代码。

items.translation: 指示未知（或未指定）SQL 类型的常量。

items.source:
Extract a common name for the target database in use even if
various drivers/platforms provide varying names at runtime.
items.translation: 即使各种驱动程序/平台在运行时提供不同的名称，也要提取目标数据库的通用名称。

items.source: Check whether the given SQL type is numeric.
items.translation: 检查给定的 SQL 类型是否为数值类型。

items.translation: 如果可能，解析给定 SQL 类型的标准类型名称。

items.source:
Close the given JDBC Connection and ignore any thrown exception.
This is useful for typical finally blocks in manual JDBC code.
items.translation: 关闭给定的 JDBC 连接，并忽略任何抛出的异常。这对于手动 JDBC 代码中的典型 `finally` 块非常有用。

items.source:
Close the given JDBC Statement and ignore any thrown exception.
This is useful for typical finally blocks in manual JDBC code.
items.translation: 关闭给定的 JDBC 语句，并忽略任何抛出的异常。这对于手动 JDBC 代码中的典型 finally 块非常有用。

items.source:

This is useful for typical finally blocks in manual JDBC code.
items.translation: 关闭给定的 JDBC ResultSet 并忽略任何抛出的异常。这对于手动 JDBC 代码中的典型 finally 块非常有用。

items.source:
Call the specified method on DatabaseMetaData for the given DataSource,
and extract the invocation result.
items.translation: 对给定的 DataSource 调用指定的 DatabaseMetaData 方法，并提取调用结果。

items.source:
Convert a property name using "camelCase" to a corresponding column name with underscores.
A name like "customerNumber" would match a "customer_number" column name.
items.translation: 使用 "camelCase" 将属性名转换为带下划线的对应列名。例如，名称 "customerNumber" 将匹配 "customer_number" 列名。

items.source:

items.translation: 将带有下划线的列名转换为对应的 "camelCase" 属性名称。例如，名称 "customer_number" 将匹配 "customerNumber" 属性名称。
